title: Add data-modeling and appsource knowledge articles (MICROSOFT layer)
summary: Seven remedial BCQuality knowledge articles added to the MICROSOFT layer covering data-modeling patterns, AppSource conventions, and styling best practices, with good and bad AL code examples for each.
key_points: Introduces 7 new knowledge articles on master-table design, number series usage, singleton setup tables, date-modified tracking, blocked field enforcement, application area requirements, and object affixes
Creates two new domains (data-modeling and appsource) alongside the existing style domain
Each article includes markdown documentation plus paired good.al and bad.al code samples demonstrating recommended versus problematic patterns
Articles reference AppSourceCop rules (AS0062, AS0011) and legacy codunits to guide developers toward preferred implementations
Knowledge index validated with 199 total articles across BCQuality
